Audit.LockedSelection.zh: 已锁定 {0} 项。请解锁后编辑这些对象。
Audit.LockedSelection.en: {0} selected items are locked. Unlock them to edit these properties.

Audit.ReplaceFont.zh: 从列表选择已安装字体以明确替换；未选择时保留原字体名。
Audit.ReplaceFont.en: Choose an installed font to replace it. The original font name is preserved until you choose.

Audit.RecentHistory.zh: 查看历史，继续上次工作 · {0}

Audit.WelcomeRestoreHint.zh: 从历史继续之前的画布，或从菜单打开已保存的工程。
Audit.WelcomeRestoreHint.en: Continue a previous canvas from history, or open a saved project from the menu.

Audit.WelcomeRestoreEmpty.zh: 还没有可恢复的历史。已保存的工程可从菜单打开。
Audit.WelcomeRestoreEmpty.en: No canvas history yet. Open a saved project from the menu to continue.

Audit.EmptyStamps.zh: 还没有印章。先在画布选择对象，再保存为印章。
Audit.EmptyStamps.en: No stamps yet. Select objects on the canvas, then save a stamp.

Audit.NoStampMatches.zh: 没有匹配的印章，试试其他关键词。
Audit.NoStampMatches.en: No matching stamps. Try a different search.

Audit.ThumbnailFailed.zh: 缩略图无法读取；右键可重试。

Audit.RequiredName.zh: 请输入名称，不能只包含空格。
Audit.RequiredName.en: Enter a name that is not only whitespace.

Audit.FeedbackHint.zh: 请描述操作步骤、预期结果与实际结果。可从“系统与调试”导出脱敏诊断包并自行检查后附上。不要包含私人画布或原始日志。打开反馈页不会自动上传内容。
Audit.FeedbackHint.en: Describe the steps, expected result and actual result. You can export a redacted diagnostic bundle from System & diagnostics and inspect it before attaching. Do not include private canvases or raw logs. Opening the issue page uploads nothing.

Audit.GuideUnavailable.zh: 此开发构建未附带用户指南。发布包在程序目录包含 User-Guide.md 与 User-Guide.en.md。
Audit.GuideUnavailable.en: This development build does not include the guide. Release packages include User-Guide.md and User-Guide.en.md beside the application.

Audit.NoUndo.en: No actions to undo on this canvas.
Audit.NoUndo.zh: 当前画布没有可撤销的操作。

Audit.NoRedo.en: No actions to redo on this canvas.
Audit.NoRedo.zh: 当前画布没有可重做的操作。

Audit.GroupRequirement.en: Select at least two unlocked objects.
Audit.GroupRequirement.zh: 请选择至少两个未锁定的对象。

Audit.UngroupRequirement.en: Select every member of a group.
Audit.UngroupRequirement.zh: 请选择一个组的所有成员。

Audit.ImageRequirement.zh: 请选择一张未锁定的图片。

Audit.SelectionRequirement.en: Select objects on the canvas first.
Audit.SelectionRequirement.zh: 请先选择画布中的对象。

Audit.EditableSelectionRequirement.zh: 请先选择未锁定的对象。
